Mission 


Build stronger communities 
by providing opportunities for 


everyone to lead fulfilling, active, 


healthy and engaged lives. 


In 2013.. 


125,000} 


people participated 
in our programs. 


35,000 children and 


teens were on the path to success 
through our programs.

1 y out Of every 2

initiatives. 


cost, or received financial 
assistance from the YMCA in 
order to participate. 


In an effort to reinforce our connection 
to local communities and to ensure 
that we remain relevant in our action, 
The YMCAs of Québec embarked on 

a strategic planning process in 2013. 
First, we measured the objectives 
achieved to date, and then we consulted 
with our partners, donors, volunteers 
and employees. Lastly, we developed 

a strategic plan for 2014-2018 that will 
allow us to build stronger, healthier and 
more engaged communities. 


The YMCA works on the front lines in 
several areas. For instance, our proven 
expertise in school retention has 


enabled us to become a member of 

the Groupe d’action sur la persévérance 
scolaire. Similarly, with our expertise in 
physical activity, we are participating in 
two initiatives: the Québec government's 
Livre vert vers une Politique du sport, 

du loisir et de I'activité physique, and the 
movement Montréal, Physically Active, 
which is aimed at implementing a 
municipal policy to promote a physically 
active lifestyle. In addition, in the fall of 
2013, YMCAs across Canada collectively 
launched a marketing campaign 
highlighting the ways the YMCA helps 
children reach their full potential: see 
ymcapotential.ca. 


Your continued support and engagement, 
which are manifested through your 
donations to the YMCA Strong Kids 
Campaign and your volunteerism, 
encourage us to be better and do more 
for our communities. Thank you for 
inspiring us! 


cjue Nac Allis 


Julie Mac Allister 
Chair of the Board of Directors 


Fifa Valllauewul— 


Stéphane Vaillancourt 
President and CEO 


MESSAGE FROM THE YMCAs OF QUEBEC 


FOUNDATION 


Working 


together for 
the success of 


youth! 


At The YMCAs of Québec 
Foundation, we believe that all 
children deserve the opportunity 
to reach their full potential. In 

2013, year one of our 2013-2015 
action plan, we clearly outlined 
our objectives in order to better 
communicate our mission to our 
3,200 donors and 1,400 volunteers. 
Specifically, our goal is to encourage 
young people from all walks of 
life, regardless of their personal or 
financial situation, to be active, 
succeed in school and develop 
their leadership. Thanks to your 
support, our various fundraising 
events and our major gift 
development strategy (all to 
benefit our youth) have been a 
huge success. 


Our Foundation draws its strength 
from its dedicated team. This year, 
the Governance and Nominating 
committee worked diligently to 
select two new members for our 
Board. All those who are interested 
and passionate about the cause of 
youth, take note! 


The Foundation is stronger than 
ever, and 2014 promises to be an 
exciting year as it steps up its 
philanthropic efforts to ensure 
The YMCAs of Québec achieves its 
strategic objectives. 


Thanks to everyone who again 
helped us make many dreams 
come true this year. 


Laurent Giguére 
President

STRATEGIC PLANNING 20}|4-2018 


Being part 


of the solution! 


Objective for 2018: 


Through our innovative and effective programs and services, partnerships and 
increased capacity to take action, we will have a greater impact on overall, health, 


youth development and social cohesion in more communities. 


“Our work is far from done! We must continue to have 
an impact on current social issues in order to make a 
difference. It is essential that we work together with 
communities and implement innovative strategies.” 


Julie Mac Allister, 
Chair of the Board of Directors 
The YMCAs of Québec 


7 


Increase 
our visibility 


Increase our visibility in order to be 
known and renowned for all our 
programs and services, notably with 
our stakeholders, by better commu- 
nicating our mission and our impact.

YMCA STRONG KIDS CAMPAIGN 


This year, our YMCA centres outdid themselves once again as they organized various fundraising activities 
that were both creative and inspiring. Thanks to the tireless efforts of our volunteers and employees, 


the YMCA Strong Kids Campaign raised $454,000. Itis worth noting that, with the help of 143 volunteer 


storytellers, online donations soared and reached $1 42,000. 
Thank you so much!
